artworks.title: Blind Beggar and Companion
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.5 × 9.6 cm (5 11/16 × 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals from head to toe. The person on the left is facing right, hunched over with a stick for support. They have a bushy beard, wear a brimmed hat, short-cropped hair, and a long cloak. The person on the right is standing straight, facing forward, with a long, disheveled beard, wearing a head wrap and loose clothing. They hold a hat in one hand. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar with Crutches and Sack
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9.3 cm (5 5/8 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with a slight hunch, using a crutch under each arm for support. He has rugged facial features with a long, unkempt beard and bushy eyebrows. He has thick, disheveled hair and wears a headband or turban. His clothing is loose and tattered, including a long cloak, layered garment, patched pants, and worn shoes. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Beggar with Rosary
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9.3 cm (5 5/8 × 3 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length figure of a person standing and slightly hunched over. The individual is holding a hat in one hand and the other arm is hanging by their side. The person has a full beard and their hair appears somewhat unkempt and short. They are wearing a flowing garment, with layered clothing visible underneath. Around the person's neck hangs a long string of large beads with a cross attached at the end. The background is a plain, textured surface that keeps the focus on the individual.

artworks.title: Beggar with Bare Head and Feet
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 8.9 cm (5 5/8 × 3 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing with his head tilted down and gazing ahead. He has shaggy unkempt hair and a short uneven beard, wearing a long tattered robe that covers his body. One hand emerges as if holding the robe closed, while his legs are covered with the same fabric and his bare feet are visible. There are no visible accessories or objects held. The background is plain with simple shaded lines near the man's feet suggesting ground or shadow.

artworks.title: The Sick Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14 × 9.1 cm (5 1/2 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This print shows a man sitting cross-legged, holding his left foot with both hands. He has a thin face, sunken eyes, tousled hair, and an overgrown beard. He is dressed in loose, draped clothing with a cloak that is fastened at the neck. A small jug with two handles is positioned between his legs. The background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Beggar with Wooden Leg
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with crutches. The person has a beard, is wearing a hat with a feather, tattered clothing, and one foot in a sandal. The background is plain.

artworks.title: One-Eyed Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly woman standing upright. She is facing forward with her head slightly tilted and a stern expression. She is dressed in a heavy gown with wide sleeves, a fur-lined muff, and boots. Her hair is covered with a matching hood. She is holding a walking stick for support and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Crutches
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with crutches. They appear to be wearing a long robe and a headscarf or bonnet, and have a neutral expression.

artworks.title: Old Beggar with One Crutch

artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back to the viewer. They are leaning slightly forward, holding a stick in their right hand. The person has long hair, wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat, baggy pants, and soft boots. The background is plain with a light texture.

artworks.title: Mother and Three Children
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.1 × 9.2 cm (5 9/16 × 3 5/8 in.)

The woman is dressed in a long dress with a head covering, while the child on her back has short, wavy hair. Beside them stands another child wearing a wide-brimmed hat, with a round face and a neutral expression. The background is plain.

artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man with long hair and a beard, leaning on a walking stick. He is wearing loose-fitting clothing and appears to be in motion. The man's hand is raised to his head, and he has deep-set eyes. The illustration is in a simple line-drawing style on an off-white background.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman with Pan

The woman's face has distinct features, including a sharp nose and furrowed brow. The background is plain, emphasizing the woman as the focal point of the image.

artworks.title: Fat Beggar with Eyes Cast Down
artworks.description: The image features a drawing of an elderly man standing upright. He is holding a stick with one hand, dressed in a long cloak and pants. He has a beard, furrowed brow, and wears a cap. The background is plain, with no other visible elements.

artworks.title: Beggar with Dog
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.3 × 9 cm (5 5/8 × 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright. They are wearing a long cloak and a broad-brimmed hat. The person has facial hair and is holding a stick in one hand and a small object in the other. A small dog is sitting at their feet. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Woman Receiving Charity

artworks.description: The image shows an older person standing in profile facing the right side. They are slightly hunched forward, holding a long walking stick in one hand and an object in the other. The person has detailed facial features, a head covering, and is dressed in layered clothing with a pouch hanging from their waist. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Beggar Eating

artworks.title: Old Woman with Cats

artworks.description: The image shows an older woman seated on a three-legged stool. She appears engaged in an activity, with her hands in front of her chest. The woman wears a headscarf, and her hair is covered by the scarf. She is draped in a long dress with wrinkles, and a small pouch hangs from her waist. Beside her, a cat sleeps on the ground. A basket filled with yarn is nearby. The background is blank.

artworks.title: Parade in the Amphitheater
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 12.4 × 30 cm (4 7/8 × 11 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a festive event taking place in a large oval arena surrounded by grand architecture and a crowd of spectators. Various groups of figures on foot and horseback are engaged in a choreographed display. Some figures carry long banners, while others appear to be in formations resembling a military exercise or pageant. The arena is encircled by a tall wooden barrier, behind which stands a packed audience extending into the background buildings. The scene conveys movement and exuberance, suggesting this is a depiction of a historical event or celebration. The architecture around the arena, with intricate facades and spectators even on rooftops, indicates a bustling urban setting. The title at the bottom translates to "The Display of Love's War at the festival of His Serene Highness the Grand Duke of Tuscany, year 1608," suggesting this is a historical representation of a grand festival or event.

artworks.title: One of the Infantry Combats
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.5 × 33 cm (8 7/8 × 13 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical spectacle in a crowded urban arena. The scene shows numerous figures engaged in what seems to be a choreographed battle or festivity, surrounded by a large audience on platforms with city architecture in the background. The composition captures the dynamic motion of the figures in the arena, with formations suggestive of mock combat and equestrian maneuvers. The assortment of figures and activities within the oval space suggests it could be depicting a grand celebration or reenactment. The intricate detailing of the buildings and crowd creates a vibrant and detailed portrayal of societal gathering from a bygone era.

artworks.title: Floats and Participants
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 22.9 × 30.4 cm (9 × 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a series of elaborately adorned carriages and figures in a grand procession. The drawing features several scenes with various allegorical and mythological representations.

In the upper left, there is a carriage labeled "Carro dell' Asia." Adjacent to it is "Carro dell' Africa." In the middle section, the "Carro di Marte e di Venere" is portrayed. Below, there are individual figures on horseback and foot soldiers, all richly dressed in period costumes, some labeled with names and titles indicating regal and military roles. The design suggests a ceremonial or festivities theme.

artworks.title: The Float of Mount Parnassus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 22.6 cm (5 7/8 × 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures gathered on a rocky mountain landscape. The background shows a tree, flowing water, and figures in dynamic poses. The figures are wearing robes and seem to be engaged in a processional or celebratory activity. One figure elevated on a rock is holding an object aloft. The scene is detailed and stylized, evoking a sense of grandeur and ritual.

artworks.title: The Float of Thetis
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15 × 22.7 cm (5 7/8 × 8 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate carriage or ceremonial float adorned with mythological figures and creatures. The central structure resembles a colonnade with foliage on top and a seated figure. Around this structure are figures that resemble mythical sea creatures or deities with tridents. The float is being drawn by two large creatures that appear to be goats. An inscription in Italian at the top describes the scene related to a prince. The style of the drawing features detailed line work and imaginative subject matter reminiscent of the High Renaissance or Baroque period.

artworks.title: The Float of the Sun
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15 × 22.9 cm (5 7/8 × 9 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a classical mythological scene involving Atlas and a chariot. The image shows a kneeling figure of Atlas holding a large globe over his shoulders, surrounded by a group of smaller figures. To the right, a procession led by a chariot drawn by four horses is depicted, driven by another figure. The scene is rich in detail, conveying a sense of motion and grandeur. The drawing captures the elaborate nature of mythical tales and their representations.

artworks.title: The Float of Love
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 14.7 × 22.6 cm (5 13/16 × 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image features curved lines forming cloud-like shapes across the scene. Small winged figures are scattered throughout, with some holding bows. In the lower part, three figures are dancing or holding hands on the clouds. In the upper left corner, a large scroll with text extends downward.
